references.text: The anointing of Aaron and his sons to the priestly service, which the Lord commanded Moses to do
The command to anoint Aaron and his sons to consecrate them for the priestly service before the Lord
The anointing of the priests was to give them a perpetual priesthood throughout their generations
The execution of the anointing of Aaron, which the Lord had commanded Moses
The priests' portion of the offering as a permanent right for them and their children, just as the Lord has commanded
The Lord's gift to Aaron of the holy offerings as a perpetual right
An everlasting covenant of salt for the priests and their descendants, an eternal statute from the Lord
